purpose: Fail-closed source-to-hash-only identity collection extraction for P2 legacy LMDB and explicitly mapped JSON, JSONL, CSV, or Parquet downstream sources. No source field, split, task, metadata key, or text unit is guessed.
required_invariants: The source is a regular non-symlink file whose bytes and SHA-256 match the config before and after parsing.
Legacy pickle deserialization is disabled unless trusted_pickle_source_sha256 exactly equals the verified source SHA-256.
LMDB metadata keys are excluded only from an explicit permitted allowlist; every required metadata key must be observed.
LMDB stat(entries) is never used as molecule count, and observed metadata keys such as __len__ are not emitted as members.
Collection phase, split, role, task family, source identity namespace, member-ID source, SMILES field, optional filter, and text unit are explicit config fields.
Every selected record yields one non-empty unique member ID and one RDKit-parsable SMILES under the supplied, hash-locked identity normalizer.
A member-ID crosscheck field, when declared, must equal the unprefixed member ID exactly after scalar string conversion.
Text extraction is either unavailable or defines exactly one semantic text unit with explicit component-name to source-field mappings.
No raw SMILES or text is written to the output; only source addresses and SHA-256 identities are emitted.
Molecule and text-pair JSONL rows are canonical, strictly UTF-8-key sorted, hash-bound, and compatible with the standalone overlap proof gate.
The extractor, config, source, identity contract, normalizer code, RDKit version, source lock, rows, collection manifest, and report are all hash-bound.
legacy_pickle_boundary: The format is a surviving project artifact, not a safe serialization. Only an explicitly SHA-256-acknowledged trusted file may be decoded in the isolated offline environment.
not_an_admission: An extraction report and collection manifest are inputs to overlap proof only. They do not decide P1/P2 overlap policy, P2 301655-vs-301658 membership, tokenizer scope, or training admission.
